analyzed_vuln.description: xmlParseNCNameComplex passes a non-null-terminated slice `(BASE_PTR + startPosition, len)` to `xmlDictLookupHashed`. In this PoV, parsing reaches end-of-input without a terminating NUL in-bounds for that slice, but dictionary hashing (`xmlDictHashName` in libxml2/dict.c) iterates with `for (i = 0; i < maxLen && data[i]; i++)`, evaluating `data[i]` first and reading one byte past the provided buffer when `i == maxLen`. This causes the ASan global-buffer-overflow read at dict.c:471.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via the xml fuzz harness (`libxml2/fuzz/xml.c`) with crafted input that starts a tag/name parse path (`xmlParseStartTag2` -> `xmlParseQNameHashed` -> `xmlParseNCNameComplex`) where the candidate NCName extends to buffer end (no in-bounds NUL terminator at `start+len`). The parser provides pointer+length to dictionary lookup; hash computation performs an out-of-bounds read at the boundary due to the loop condition ordering in `xmlDictHashName`.
